title.narrative: Improving access to justice by strengthening young Bolivian human rights lawyers' skills and action

description.narrative: This is a small-scale project being implemented by CAFOD partner UNITAS to build a community of human rights defenders, particularly young lawyers, with increased capacity to respond to the needs of civil society. At present there are very few human rights organisations and even fewer human rights lawyers operating to uphold the rule of law in Bolivia and their capacity to respond to the changing context is limited. There is an increasing demand for the services of human rights lawyers to defend victims of violations of civil, political, economic, social and cultural and environmental rights both of individuals, communities, indigenous people and NGOs (both Bolivian and international). This project will build on the work of previous years in which young lawyers have been trained in human rights, forming a core group committed to helping social organisations in Bolivia to protect democracy and their rights. This new phase will support the group in working closely with social organisations, improving their practical legal skills and increase their capacity.
